assertions.assertion: Configures UseForwardedHeaders with ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedFor and ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedProto
assertions.rationale: ForwardedHeadersOptions includes XForwardedFor and XForwardedProto (plus Host), applied via UseForwardedHeaders.
